created_at.description: The time when the employee entity was created, in ISO 8601 format. Is set by Square when the Role is created.

id.description: The role's unique ID, Can only be set by Square.

is_owner.description: If true, employees with this role have all permissions, regardless of the values indicated in permissions.

updated_at.description: The time when the employee entity was most recently updated, in ISO 8601 format. Is set by Square when the Role updated.

operations.name: Update invoice
operations.description: Updates an invoice by modifying fields, clearing fields, or both. For most updates, you can use a sparse `Invoice` object to add fields or change values and use the `fields_to_clear` field to specify fields to clear. However, some restrictions apply. For example, you cannot change the `order_id` or `location_id` field and you must provide the complete `custom_fields` list to update a custom field.

invoice_id.description: The ID of the invoice to update.

fields_to_clear.description: The list of fields to clear. For examples, see [Update an invoice](https://developer.squareup.com/docs/invoices-api/overview#update-an-invoice).

idempotency_key.description: A unique string that identifies the `UpdateInvoice` request. If you do not provide `idempotency_key` (or provide an empty string as the value), the endpoint treats each request as independent. For more information, see [Idempotency](https://developer.squareup.com/docs/working-with-apis/idempotency).

invoice.description: Stores information about an invoice. You use the Invoices API to create and manage invoices. For more information, see [Manage Invoices Using the Invoices API](https://developer.squareup.com/docs/invoices-api/overview).

operations.name: Update item modifier lists
operations.description: Updates the [CatalogModifierList](https://developer.squareup.com/reference/square_2021-08-18/objects/CatalogModifierList) objects that apply to the targeted [CatalogItem](https://developer.squareup.com/reference/square_2021-08-18/objects/CatalogItem) without having to perform an upsert on the entire item.

item_ids.description: The IDs of the catalog items associated with the CatalogModifierList objects being updated.

modifier_lists_to_disable.description: The IDs of the CatalogModifierList objects to disable for the CatalogItem.

modifier_lists_to_enable.description: The IDs of the CatalogModifierList objects to enable for the CatalogItem.

operations.name: Update item taxes
operations.description: Updates the [CatalogTax](https://developer.squareup.com/reference/square_2021-08-18/objects/CatalogTax) objects that apply to the targeted [CatalogItem](https://developer.squareup.com/reference/square_2021-08-18/objects/CatalogItem) without having to perform an upsert on the entire item.

item_ids.description: IDs for the CatalogItems associated with the CatalogTax objects being updated.

taxes_to_disable.description: IDs of the CatalogTax objects to disable.

taxes_to_enable.description: IDs of the CatalogTax objects to enable.

operations.name: Update location
operations.description: Updates a location.

location_id.description: The ID of the location to update.

operations.name: Update order
operations.description: Updates the details of an online store order. Every update you perform on an order corresponds to one of three actions:

location_id.description: The ID of the order's associated location.

order_id.description: The order's Square-issued ID. You obtain this value from Order objects returned by the List Orders endpoint

action.description: The action to perform on the order (COMPLETE, CANCEL, or REFUND).

canceled_note.description: A merchant-specified note about the canceling of the order. Only valid if action is CANCEL.

completed_note.description: A merchant-specified note about the completion of the order. Only valid if action is COMPLETE.

refunded_note.description: A merchant-specified note about the refunding of the order. Only valid if action is REFUND.

shipped_tracking_number.description: The tracking number of the shipment associated with the order. Only valid if action is COMPLETE.

operations.name: Update payment
operations.description: Updates a payment with the APPROVED status. You can update the `amount_money` and `tip_money` using this endpoint.

payment_id.description: The ID of the payment to update.

idempotency_key.description: A unique string that identifies this `UpdatePayment` request. Keys can be any valid string but must be unique for every `UpdatePayment` request. The maximum is 45 characters. For more information, see [Idempotency](https://developer.squareup.com/docs/basics/api101/idempotency).

payment.description: Represents a payment processed by the Square API.

operations.name: Update shift
operations.description: Updates an existing `Shift`. When adding a `Break` to a `Shift`, any earlier `Break` instances in the `Shift` have the `end_at` property set to a valid RFC-3339 datetime string. When closing a `Shift`, all `Break` instances in the `Shift` must be complete with `end_at` set on each `Break`.

id.description: The ID of the object being updated.

shift.description: A record of the hourly rate, start, and end times for a single work shift for an employee. This might include a record of the start and end times for breaks taken during the shift.

operations.name: Update subscription
operations.description: Updates a subscription. You can set, modify, and clear the `subscription` field values.

subscription_id.description: The ID for the subscription to update.

subscription.description: Represents a customer subscription to a subscription plan. For an overview of the `Subscription` type, see [Subscription object](https://developer.squareup.com/docs/subscriptions-api/overview#subscription-object-overview).

operations.name: Update team member
operations.description: Updates a single `TeamMember` object. The `TeamMember` object is returned on successful updates. Learn about [Troubleshooting the Team API](https://developer.squareup.com/docs/team/troubleshooting#update-a-team-member).

team_member_id.description: The ID of the team member to update.

team_member.description: A record representing an individual team member for a business.

operations.name: Update wage setting
operations.description: Creates or updates a `WageSetting` object. The object is created if a `WageSetting` with the specified `team_member_id` does not exist. Otherwise, it fully replaces the `WageSetting` object for the team member. The `WageSetting` is returned on a successful update. Learn about [Troubleshooting the Team API](https://developer.squareup.com/docs/team/troubleshooting#create-or-update-a-wage-setting).

team_member_id.description: The ID of the team member for which to update the `WageSetting` object.

wage_setting.description: An object representing a team member's wage information.

operations.name: Update workweek config
operations.description: Updates a `WorkweekConfig`.

id.description: The UUID for the `WorkweekConfig` object being updated.

workweek_config.description: Sets the day of the week and hour of the day that a business starts a workweek. This is used to calculate overtime pay.

operations.name: Void transaction
operations.description: Cancels a transaction that was created with the [Charge](https://developer.squareup.com/reference/square_2021-08-18/transactions-api/charge) endpoint with a `delay_capture` value of `true`.
